Kiran P: quick note  were seeing tenants explicitly set X-API-Version: v2 but still route to v1. Repro in logs.
Mei Z: any pattern? token affinity present?
Kiran P: yes token present but no explicit version metadata. Some clients expect header to override.
Alan R: current behavior: token_affinity > header > fallback. Changing global order is risky.
Priya S: propose a preflight: (1) audit-only sampling to record "would_have_used_header" decisions, (2) a per-tenant tri-state toggle: off/audit/enforce, (3) projection job to estimate pool/quota impact.
Mei Z: agree. Sampling rate 0.5% global, 5% for targeted tenants. Emit metric `routing.header_audit.count` with tag `tenant`.
Alan R: projection should show estimated sessions moved, cost delta, and latency percentiles. Add dashboard tile and support alert if projected quota shortfall > 10%.
Kiran P: runbook snippet: if enforce causes >2x error rate for 5m or >3% absolute increase, auto-revert to previous affinity for 30m and page oncall.
Priya S: Console UX: toggle labeled "Prefer client header" + "Estimate impact" button that runs projection on demand. Default to audit.
ops-bot: Created ENG-5107: "header-precedence preflight + projection + console toggle" assigned to @Alan R and @Mei Z. ETA: 5 days for audit + projection POC.
Mei Z: I'll drop dashboard mocks later today. Keeping sampling conservative to avoid metric blow-up.
Kiran P: thanks, leaving thread open for updates.
